mapper.sql: select a.id, a.bill_no, a.contract_id, ct.contact_no, ct.contract_name, a.customer_id, cu.name as customer_name, a.supplier_id, s.name as supplier_name, a.bill_cycle, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.total_tokens, a.total_sell_amount, a.total_cost_amount, a.total_gross_profit, a.bill_status, a.remark, a.auditor, au.user_name as auditor_name, a.audit_time, a.creator, cr.user_name as creator_name, a.create_time, a.update_time, (select count(1) from crm_contract_usage u where u.bill_id = a.id) as usage_count, (select count(1) from crm_contract_bill_diff d where d.handle_status = 0 and d.supplier_id = a.supplier_id and d.call_time >= a.start_time and d.call_time <= a.end_time) as pending_diff_count from crm_contract_bill a left join crm_contract ct on a.contract_id = ct.id left join crm_customer cu on a.customer_id = cu.id left join crm_supplier s on a.supplier_id = s.id left join sys_user au on a.auditor = au.user_id left join sys_user cr on a.creator = cr.user_id
mapper.select: select id, bill_no, contract_id, customer_id, supplier_id, supplier_account_id, bill_cycle, start_time, end_time, total_tokens, total_sell_amount, total_cost_amount, total_gross_profit, bill_status, remark, creator, auditor, audit_time, create_time, update_time from crm_contract_bill where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into crm_contract_bill ( bill_no, contract_id, customer_id, supplier_id, supplier_account_id, bill_cycle, start_time, end_time, total_tokens, total_sell_amount, total_cost_amount, total_gross_profit, bill_status, remark, creator, create_time ) values ( #{billNo}, #{contractId}, #{customerId}, #{supplierId}, ifnull(#{supplierAccountId}, 0), #{billCycle}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, ifnull(#{totalTokens}, 0), ifnull(#{totalSellAmount}, 0), ifnull(#{totalCostAmount}, 0), ifnull(#{totalGrossProfit}, 0), ifnull(#{billStatus}, 1), #{remark}, #{creator}, ifnull(#{createTime}, sysdate()) )
mapper.update: update crm_contract_bill set bill_status = #{billStatus}, remark = #{remark}, auditor = #{auditor}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from crm_contract_bill where contract_id = #{contractId} and supplier_id = #{supplierId} and bill_cycle = #{billCycle}
select count(1) from crm_contract_bill where supplier_id = #{supplierId} and bill_cycle = #{billCycle}
